subject: Quick recap + pick a time for a technical walkthrough

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nguyen <chris.nguyen@averysys.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <p.rao@averysys.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + pick a time for a technical walkthrough

Hi Chris — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap from my side so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency customer-facing features (real-time scoring, <150ms p95 target).
- Primary constraints: VPC/private deployment, SSO (SAML / Okta), and audit logs / retention policy for compliance.
- Scale profile: initial pilot ~5k monthly users, bursty peak traffic; likely model quantization to save cost.

Next step: technical walkthrough (45–60 min) with your infra and security folks + our solutions/security engineers to map integration and evidence path. Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 22 — 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00
- Wed Dec 23 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu Dec 24 — 08:30–09:30

If those don’t work, share two preferred times and I’ll lock something in. Can you also confirm who on your side should join from security and procurement (or loop them in here)? I’ll attach a short demo agenda and include Marissa (solutions) and Hannah (security) on the next thread.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
David Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
M: (415) 555-0198
david.kim@redwood.com

Perfect — Wed Dec 23, 10:00–11:00 PST is locked on my calendar.

Marissa (solutions engineer) and Hannah (security lead) from our side are now copied — they’ll cover integration patterns, VPC/SAML setup, and the audit/logging evidence we discussed. Attached is a short agenda so the call stays timeboxed:

Agenda (attached: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf)
1) 5m intros & scope
2) 20m architecture walk — deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and networking model
3) 20m integration & security — SSO, key management, audit logs, data flows
4) 10m next steps & responsibilities (procurement, POC timeline)

Action items for the Wed call:
- Chris / Marcus: confirm whether you prefer our VPC deployed in your cloud account or a dedicated Redwood VPC.
- Priya: if procurement needs a separate short session, suggest a 30-minute slot before the demo — we can accommodate Fri Dec 24 afternoon PST or Mon Dec 27 morning PST.
- Everyone: please review the attached agenda and add any must-have topics.

Looking forward to it — I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom and a HubSpot record link.

Cheers,
David

Thanks — we’ll join the Wed demo. A couple of procurement asks before we confirm the POC paperwork: 

- Can you share a redacted SOC 2 (Type II) report or a SOC 2 letter and your data retention / deletion policy? We need this for our legal intake.
- Data residency: we need confirmation that logs and customer data can be kept in us-east-1 for the pilot.
- Pricing: a rough ballpark for a 3-month pilot with the profile David mentioned would be helpful so procurement can prep commercial approvals.

If procurement needs a standalone 30-minute session, Fri Dec 24 at 14:00 PST works best for our team. If not, we’ll join the Wed demo and follow up afterward.
